#e[Up and Up]#n

Thank you everyone for coming! Here are the rules.

The [Up and Up] game is similar to a #bladder game#k. #rWinning and losing are heavily based on luck#k.
When you pass through all gateways within the time limit, you will be moved to an area to get prizes! There are #b3 stages#k to the gateways.
The time limit is #r6 minutes#k, and after that the game will #bend automatically#k. [Up and Up] #rdoes not allow#k #bjumps#k, #bteleports#k, or #bhastes#k.

More details can be provided within the game.
